description: SCOUT's Deep Umbra shadow model, ported from SCOUT (urban-toolkit/scout): the Accumulated Shadow node predicts how long the ground stays in shadow over a season's day from the zoom-16 height mosaic of SCOUT Raster Conversion, as a raster in minutes that an Autark map draws and a Raster Statistics node sums up. The model is the Model Catalog's Deep Umbra, model.scout.deep-umbra@1, which ships in the Curio repository but not in the pip package.
name: SCOUT Shadow

templates.description: SCOUT's accumulated shadow simulation: Deep Umbra, a generator network, predicts for each zoom-16 map tile how much of a season's day each cell spends in shadow, from the heights of the buildings on the tile and its eight neighbours, the tile's latitude and the season. Input: the height mosaic of Rasterize Buildings: a RASTER of building heights in metres in EPSG:3395 on the zoom-16 tile grid. Output: one RASTER of the accumulated shadow in minutes on the input's grid, for an Autark map. SCOUT's metrics, the mean and median accumulated shadow over the ground, are a Raster Statistics node's on this raster, with the heights on its input 1 as the mask and the ground where the height is under 1.08 m. The model is the Model Catalog's Deep Umbra, model.scout.deep-umbra.
templates.label: Accumulated Shadow
